text: This report recommends approving an agreement with Triumph Roofing & Sheet Metal Inc. ("Triumph") for the non-exclusive provision of roofing contractor repair services for a one-year term with three (3) one-year options to renew. This recommendation follows the competitive Request for Quotation process undertaken by Exhibition Place through the City of Toronto Purchasing and Materials Management Division considering five (5) companies that have experiences providing these services.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved an agreement with Triumph Roofing & Sheet Metal Inc. for the non-exclusive provision of roofing contractor repair services for a one-year term with three (3) one-year options to renew on the terms and conditions set out in the report (November 1, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and such other terms and conditions required by the Chief Executive Officer and the City Solicitor.
